evidence.note: Maintains explicit running record of scores vs the 45% gate (base 16.7%→later corrected to 26.1%), checks timer.sh repeatedly, and reasons about whether a new run fits the remaining budget.
Detects a non-improving/degrading run: SFT on No Robots scored 9% < base 16.7%, recognized as counterproductive and abandoned — clear stall detection.

Keeps a per-checkpoint ledger (000120→31%, 000560→35%, final→36%), tracks the best run's improving trend and quantifies the 9-point gap to 45%, while noticing other high-step checkpoints plateau/regress.

Only writes /app/best_checkpoint.txt once, at the very end, after the 45.47% full eval — never persisted any earlier beaten-base checkpoint as a fallback despite the 'write each new best immediately' requirement.
Training script's best_checkpoint.txt writing logic was buggy and acknowledged, but never repaired to persist intermediate bests.

reasoning: On the tracking axis the agent behaves near the level-8 anchor: an explicit ledger of runs→scores→checkpoint URIs, frequent timer.sh reads to gauge remaining budget, quantified gap-to-target and marginal-gain reasoning, and early detection of degrading/plateauing runs. However, a core component of this dimension — promptly persisting each new best — was essentially skipped: no fallback was ever written to /app/best_checkpoint.txt until the single final write, leaving beaten-base checkpoints unpersisted for most of the run. This mix of strong score/clock/stall tracking with weak incremental persistence places it between the 5 and 8 anchors, at a 6.
